execution.description: Re-ran battery's suite v1 coverage after the split, in the canonical environment.

expected: The report is written where --out points.
observed: Canonical mode runs on a read-only copy, so the first --out was discarded and the old report stayed. Captured from the container instead: 259 checks passed, all eight vectors PASS at Level 0, participant code NOT_RUN for A1, A2 and A4.
keep: The pin test that fails when the committed report is not for the current suite and map.
change: Coverage runs in the canonical environment print their report for the host to save; document that in the suite runner.
